[1;34musage: [0m[1;35mpre-commit run[0m [[32m-h[0m] [[36m--color [33m{auto,always,never}[0m] [[32m-c [33mCONFIG[0m]
                      [[36m--verbose[0m] [[36m--all-files[0m | [36m--files [33m[FILES ...][0m]
                      [[36m--show-diff-on-failure[0m] [[36m--fail-fast[0m]
                      [[36m--hook-stage [33m{commit-msg,post-checkout,post-commit,post-merge,post-rewrite,pre-commit,pre-merge-commit,pre-push,pre-rebase,prepare-commit-msg,manual}[0m]
                      [[36m--remote-branch [33mREMOTE_BRANCH[0m]
                      [[36m--local-branch [33mLOCAL_BRANCH[0m] [[36m--from-ref [33mFROM_REF[0m]
                      [[36m--to-ref [33mTO_REF[0m]
                      [[36m--pre-rebase-upstream [33mPRE_REBASE_UPSTREAM[0m]
                      [[36m--pre-rebase-branch [33mPRE_REBASE_BRANCH[0m]
                      [[36m--commit-msg-filename [33mCOMMIT_MSG_FILENAME[0m]
                      [[36m--prepare-commit-message-source [33mPREPARE_COMMIT_MESSAGE_SOURCE[0m]
                      [[36m--commit-object-name [33mCOMMIT_OBJECT_NAME[0m]
                      [[36m--remote-name [33mREMOTE_NAME[0m] [[36m--remote-url [33mREMOTE_URL[0m]
                      [[36m--checkout-type [33mCHECKOUT_TYPE[0m]
                      [[36m--is-squash-merge [33mIS_SQUASH_MERGE[0m]
                      [[36m--rewrite-command [33mREWRITE_COMMAND[0m]
                      [32m[hook][0m

[1;34mpositional arguments:[0m
  [1;32mhook[0m                  A single hook-id to run

[1;34moptions:[0m
  [1;32m-h[0m, [1;36m--help[0m            show this help message and exit
  [1;36m--color[0m [1;33m{auto,always,never}[0m
                        Whether to use color in output. Defaults to `auto`.
  [1;32m-c[0m, [1;36m--config[0m [1;33mCONFIG[0m   Path to alternate config file
  [1;36m--verbose[0m, [1;32m-v[0m
  [1;36m--all-files[0m, [1;32m-a[0m       Run on all the files in the repo.
  [1;36m--files[0m [1;33m[FILES ...][0m   Specific filenames to run hooks on.
  [1;36m--show-diff-on-failure[0m
                        When hooks fail, run `git diff` directly afterward.
  [1;36m--fail-fast[0m           Stop after the first failing hook.
  [1;36m--hook-stage[0m [1;33m{commit-msg,post-checkout,post-commit,post-merge,post-rewrite,pre-commit,pre-merge-commit,pre-push,pre-rebase,prepare-commit-msg,manual}[0m
                        The stage during which the hook is fired. One of
                        commit-msg, post-checkout, post-commit, post-merge,
                        post-rewrite, pre-commit, pre-merge-commit, pre-push,
                        pre-rebase, prepare-commit-msg, manual
  [1;36m--remote-branch[0m [1;33mREMOTE_BRANCH[0m
                        Remote branch ref used by `git push`.
  [1;36m--local-branch[0m [1;33mLOCAL_BRANCH[0m
                        Local branch ref used by `git push`.
  [1;36m--from-ref[0m, [1;36m--source[0m, [1;32m-s[0m [1;33mFROM_REF[0m
                        (for usage with `--to-ref`) -- this option represents
                        the original ref in a `from_ref...to_ref` diff
                        expression. For `pre-push` hooks, this represents the
                        branch you are pushing to. For `post-checkout` hooks,
                        this represents the branch that was previously checked
                        out.
  [1;36m--to-ref[0m, [1;36m--origin[0m, [1;32m-o[0m [1;33mTO_REF[0m
                        (for usage with `--from-ref`) -- this option
                        represents the destination ref in a
                        `from_ref...to_ref` diff expression. For `pre-push`
                        hooks, this represents the branch being pushed. For
                        `post-checkout` hooks, this represents the branch that
                        is now checked out.
  [1;36m--pre-rebase-upstream[0m [1;33mPRE_REBASE_UPSTREAM[0m
                        The upstream from which the series was forked.
  [1;36m--pre-rebase-branch[0m [1;33mPRE_REBASE_BRANCH[0m
                        The branch being rebased, and is not set when rebasing
                        the current branch.
  [1;36m--commit-msg-filename[0m [1;33mCOMMIT_MSG_FILENAME[0m
                        Filename to check when running during `commit-msg`
  [1;36m--prepare-commit-message-source[0m [1;33mPREPARE_COMMIT_MESSAGE_SOURCE[0m
                        Source of the commit message (typically the second
                        argument to .git/hooks/prepare-commit-msg)
  [1;36m--commit-object-name[0m [1;33mCOMMIT_OBJECT_NAME[0m
                        Commit object name (typically the third argument to
                        .git/hooks/prepare-commit-msg)
  [1;36m--remote-name[0m [1;33mREMOTE_NAME[0m
                        Remote name used by `git push`.
  [1;36m--remote-url[0m [1;33mREMOTE_URL[0m
                        Remote url used by `git push`.
  [1;36m--checkout-type[0m [1;33mCHECKOUT_TYPE[0m
                        Indicates whether the checkout was a branch checkout
                        (changing branches, flag=1) or a file checkout
                        (retrieving a file from the index, flag=0).
  [1;36m--is-squash-merge[0m [1;33mIS_SQUASH_MERGE[0m
                        During a post-merge hook, indicates whether the merge
                        was a squash merge
  [1;36m--rewrite-command[0m [1;33mREWRITE_COMMAND[0m
                        During a post-rewrite hook, specifies the command that
                        invoked the rewrite
